rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Lanthanoids: Ce(58)–Lu(71), +3 dominant, f electrons shield poorly → lanthanoid contraction; actinoids: Th(90)–Lr(103), radioactivity, wider oxidation range (U +6).  ·  Trick 2: Consequences of contraction: similar radii → similar properties → difficult separation (ion-exchange/solvent extraction) — the application line.
